caption_L1: This is a bar plot named Average contributed income of not-for-profit theatres in the United States by contributor from 2010 to 2018 (in thousand U.S. dollars). The y-axis shows 2013. There is a categorical scale from City/County to United arts funds on the x-axis, marked not-for-profit theatres.
caption_L2L3: The United States Art Fund contributed the least amount of money to not-for-profit theatres (about $20,000), closely followed by Federal contributions (about $30,000). By far the greatest amount of contributions came from the category "other sources" standing at around $750,000. Foundations were the second largest contributors giving some $500,000.
